scripts.dev: CHURCH_EXEC_PURPOSE=development varlock run --path . -- node --import tsx/esm --watch src/main/server.ts
scripts.export:openapi: CHURCH_EXEC_PURPOSE=development varlock run --path . -- bun run src/scripts/export-openapi.ts
scripts.db:init-system: CHURCH_EXEC_PURPOSE=development varlock run --path . -- bun run src/scripts/init-system.ts
scripts.start:e2e: CHURCH_EXEC_PURPOSE=e2e varlock run --path . -- sh -c 'bun --no-env-file ../../tooling/env/e2e-process-preflight.ts server && exec node --import tsx/esm src/main/server.ts'
scripts.test:integration: CHURCH_EXEC_PURPOSE=integration bun ../../tooling/diagnostics/run-managed.ts test:integration --step server -- varlock run --path . -- bun vitest run --project integration
scripts.test: bun run test:unit && bun run test:integration
